description: Opens a new webinar conversation and returns the first question with tappable options. No sign-in and no setup. Take it when a host wants to begin, for example "I want to run a webinar about my coaching, where do we start?" It creates a session on the connector and returns a session id. Nothing is written to a WordPress site, nothing is published and no email goes out. You can pass what the host just said and what you already know about topic, audience, offer and tone, then the conversation opens there instead of at an empty menu. Words hosts use: start a webinar, begin, first webinar, no setup

has_wi.description: true when WebinarIgnition is already installed on the host's site.

has_wordpress.description: true when the host already has a WordPress site. Reist als Fluss-Signal mit: ohne es gilt der Standardweg (der Host hat vermutlich WordPress). Mit false wird der Verbinden-Schritt in der Strecke uebersprungen.

known_facts.description: What the host already said about the webinar: topic, audience, offer, tone, date. Send it on the FIRST call (this call or this call) so the conversation does not ask again what is already known. Later calls keep it in the session and do not need it again.

language.description: The language the host writes in.

situation.description: Only with this call or this call: what the host just said, in their own words. On this call this also starts a real conversation (seeded with known_facts) instead of only showing the menu — use it when the host already wrote something about their webinar.

name: wi_start_webinar
title: Start a webinar
